nodes.description: address private owner; privileged game administrator address used in onlyOwner checks.
address private bankroll; address allowed to feed external balance updates and change ownership.
bool public gamePaused; read by the gameIsActive modifier.
bool public canMining; toggles optional mining payout inside _spinTokens.
uint public miningProfit; percentage basis points used for mining payout computation.
uint public minBetMining; threshold below which no mining payout happens.
uint public minBet = 1e18; minimum wager enforced by betIsValid.
uint public maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse; governs max payout share of tracked balance.
mapping (uint => uint) public maxProfit; precomputed per-divRate profit caps.
mapping (uint => uint) public contractBalance; tracked bankroll balance per divRate.
uint public totalSpins; cumulative spin counter.
uint public totalZTHWagered; cumulative tokens wagered.
address public zlotsJackpot; jackpot contract address used for payouts.
mapping(address => playerSpin) public playerSpins; pending spin record per player.
address[7] UsedBankrollAddresses; tiered token bankroll contracts.
mapping(address => bool) ValidBankrollAddress; whitelist checked by fromBankroll.
ZethrInterface Zethr; hardcoded main Zethr token contract interface.
address private ZTHTKNADDR; expected ZTH token address used by _zthToken.
constructor(address BankrollAddress); wires bankroll, sets owner to msg.sender and initial config.
function() public payable; accepts ETH dividends destined for the bankroll.
execute(address,uint,uint,bytes) fromBankroll gameIsActive; entry point invoked by the token bankroll.
_spinTokens(TKN,uint,uint8) private; validates wager, stores pending spin and pays mining fee.
finishSpin() public gameIsActive; public wrapper that settles msg.sender's pending spin.
_finishSpin(address) private; resolves rolls, computes profit and performs external payouts.
maxRandom(uint,address,uint) private view; keccak256 over blockhash, entropy and index.
random(uint256,uint256,address,uint) internal view; reduces maxRandom modulo upper bound.
setMaxProfit(uint) internal; recomputes maxProfit[divRate] with unchecked arithmetic.
getMaxProfit(uint) public view; returns unchecked max profit for a divRate.
getNewMaxProfit(uint,uint) public view; subtracts current win before computing cap with unchecked math.
subContractBalance(uint,uint) internal; SafeMath subtraction on tracked balance.
addContractBalance(uint,uint) internal; SafeMath addition on tracked balance.
ownerUpdateContractBalance(uint,uint) public onlyOwner; direct write to a divRate balance.
updateContractBalance(uint) public onlyOwner; bulk-writes balances for all tiers.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens(uint,uint) public fromBankroll; external balance sync.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse(uint) public onlyOwner; bounded config setter.
ownerSetMinBet(uint) public onlyOwner; sets the minimum wager.
ownerPauseGame(bool) public onlyOwner; toggles gamePaused.
ownerSetCanMining(bool) public onlyOwner; toggles canMining.
ownerSetMiningProfit(uint) public onlyOwner; sets mining profit basis points.
ownerSetMinBetMining(uint) public onlyOwner; sets the mining threshold.
ownerSetZlotsAddress(address) public onlyOwner; sets the jackpot contract address.
changeOwner(address) public onlyOwnerOrBankroll; transfers ownership.
changeBankroll(address) public onlyOwnerOrBankroll; swaps the bankroll address.
_zthToken(address) private view; compares against ZTHTKNADDR.
setupBankrollInterface(address) internal; loads and whitelists the 7 bankroll addresses.
RequestBankrollPayment(address,uint,uint) internal; selects tier bankroll and calls it.
getZethrTokenBankroll(uint) public view; maps divRate to bankroll contract.
WithdrawToBankroll() public; transfers full balance to tier-0 bankroll address.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll() public; calls Zethr.withdraw then WithdrawToBankroll.
ZethrTierLibrary.getTier(uint) internal pure; maps divRate to a 0-6 tier index.
SafeMath.mul(uint,uint) internal pure; overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div(uint,uint) internal pure; truncating division.
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint) internal pure; underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.add(uint,uint) internal pure; overflow-checked addition.
msg.sender; controls access checks, spin ownership and owner/bankroll assignment.
External call ZethrTokenBankroll(tokenBankrollAddress).gameRequestTokens(to,tokens).
External call ZlotsJackpotHoldingContract(zlotsJackpot).payOutWinner(target).
Unchecked multiply/divide/subtract on contractBalance and maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
Outcome randomness derived only from blockhash of a past block plus caller-supplied entropy.
constructor parameter BankrollAddress fed to setupBankrollInterface.
execute parameter _from; original token sender recorded in TKN.
execute parameter _value; wager amount in tokens.
execute/_spinTokens parameter divRate; selects tier and balance bucket.
_finishSpin parameter target; address that receives the payout.
changeOwner parameter _newOwner.
changeBankroll parameter _newBankroll.
ownerSetMinBet parameter newMinimumBet.
ownerSetZlotsAddress parameter zlotsAddress.
ownerUpdateContractBalance parameter newContractBalance.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse parameter newMaxProfitAsPercent.
betIsValid modifier parameter _betSize.
TKN memory _tkn built inside execute from _from/_value.
playerSpin memory spin loaded and written back in _spinTokens/_finishSpin.
uint result; per-roll random outcome in _finishSpin.
uint profit; per-roll payout amount in _finishSpin.
uint[] output; per-spin result array returned by _finishSpin.
rollData outcomeTrack; aggregates win/loss/jackpot totals across spins.
uint miningAmout; mining payout computed in _spinTokens.

ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.

_spinTokens derives the tier index from divRate.
getZethrTokenBankroll consumes the tier library result.

_spinTokens reads the existing playerSpins record.
_spinTokens increments totalSpins.
_spinTokens increments totalZTHWagered.
_spinTokens branches on the canMining flag.
_spinTokens reads miningProfit for the mining payout.
_spinTokens computes mining payout via SafeMath.mul.
_spinTokens computes mining payout via SafeMath.div.
_spinTokens requests the mining payout from the bankroll.
_finishSpin generates each roll result with random().
random delegates to maxRandom for entropy.
blockhash-derived entropy feeds the weak randomness operation.
_finishSpin computes profit via SafeMath.mul.
_finishSpin computes profit via SafeMath.div.

_finishSpin calls payOutWinner on the jackpot contract mid-settlement.

_finishSpin clears the playerSpins entry at the end.
_finishSpin reads zlotsJackpot for jackpot and loss routing.

ownerSetMinBetMining writes minBetMining.

changeBankroll reassigns the privileged bankroll address.

setupBankrollInterface whitelists each bankroll address.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument only used to seed the bankroll interface during deployment.
Token sender argument is consumed only when building the TKN struct inside execute.
Wager value argument flows solely into the TKN struct handled by execute.
divRate argument is only meaningful as the tier selector passed into the spin flow.
Payout target argument is used exclusively to route winnings and jackpot payouts.
Assignment-only argument for the owner state variable.
Assignment-only argument for the bankroll state variable.
Administrative value written straight into contractBalance.
Bounded configuration value written into maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
betIsValid modifier argument that gates the _spinTokens wager path.
Temporary struct materialised and immediately forwarded by execute.
Pending spin record read back and cleared during settlement.
Random draw value that only exists to pick the payout category branch.
Accumulator for the payout computed inside the settlement loop.
Return buffer holding per-spin results from the settlement loop.
Aggregation struct that decides which external bankroll payments are made.
Mining payout amount forwarded to the external bankroll payment request.
